title: bounds-guard patch for view-OOB (test-first against golden anchor)
base_note: main tip = ENGINE-34 squash (PR #194); defect golden from pre-squash f16f5d57d

defect.summary: isSeatConfirmed (V2 L548 / Fast L429) and settlementPayouts (V2 L556 / Fast L437) panicked Panic(0x32) (storage array OOB) for settlementId >= settlements.length, while claimablePayout (V2 L529) was defensive (OOB -> 0). UI/indexer polling before first initiateSettlement received a revert, not a value.

behavior.isSeatConfirmed: if (settlementId >= settlements.length) return false; added as first statement; raw==0 short-circuit order preserved (golden g3/g8 pins)
behavior.settlementPayouts: if (settlementId >= settlements.length) return new uint256[](0); added before the array read
